summary: A pneumatic harpoon gun, 0.85 m: an anodised aluminium air barrel with a rubber butt cap and charging valve… joints trigger, safety, reel, harpoon; options barrel_colour; sockets socket_muzzle, spear_tip, grip_r, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.harpoon_gun or place "prefab": "harpoon_gun" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
